description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RWE Supply & Trading Americas, LLC is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to design, build, and support internal applications in collaboration with technology teams and the commercial business. The role includes writing and debugging code, building applications with technologies such as .Net and Angular, and troubleshooting software issues.
Junior Software Engineer building and maintaining .NET and Angular applications, debugging code and troubleshooting software issues

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with other developers and engineers to design, build, and maintain applications
• Build applications using common frameworks, such as .Net, Angular
• Write and debug code
• Troubleshoot software issues

Requirements:
• Basic understanding of at least one Object Oriented language
• Basic experience in front-end and back-end software development
• Fundamental understanding of web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively
• familiar with coding concepts and at least one high level programming language
• comfortable and willing to learn these technologies

Preferred:
• Previous internship experience or contributions to open-source projects
• Experience with MongoDB a plus
